    Reduced-word l2 Hilbert-sum skeleton (scalar-vacuum free-product space) #

    Reduced words over X, the ℂ-tensor word fibers WordFiber K0 H, the l2 sum Khat K0 H := lp WordFiber 2, and the common-H vacuum inclusion.

    Scope caveat. This ℂ-tensor Khat (fibers K0 x₁ ⊗_ℂ … ⊗_ℂ K0 xₙ ⊗_ℂ H) is the scalar-vacuum (H = ℂ) free-product Hilbert space. For the operator-valued Boca u.c.p. free product (general target H) it is NOT the correct object: the ℂ-tensor over-counts for dim H > 1 (single-x sector dimension d + d² vs the required 2d), because the vacuum H is not a tensor unit — the correct Boca space needs H-relative (Connes-fusion) completed tensors ⊗̂_H. Everything here is a true kernel-trio fact about the scalar-vacuum space, but it does NOT carry the factor PVM Q x i for general H. The reduced-word combinatorics are reusable at any completion level. The final permanence proof now uses the separate direct-sum dilation in BocaDilation*; this scalar-tensor route remains intentionally excluded from that proof.
